title: Answer: inspect the proofs, audit the whale results, replicate across species

statements.text: The stated checks are inspection of the proof stack, an audit of how the operators and witnesses were derived, an audit of the hashed whale results, and replication across species. For rival theories the stated test is whether a formalism still derives physical structure from phenomenal axioms.

sources.quote: the verification path exists through proof-stack inspection, operator and witness derivation audit, cetacean hash and artifact audit, and cross-species replication
Does it still derive physical structure from phenomenal axioms, treating the two as antecedently distinct relata of a bridge?
